title: Five Indian Shuttlers to Watch at BWF World Championships 2026
indian_angle: This article highlights promising Indian shuttlers who are expected to perform well at the upcoming BWF World Championships hosted in New Delhi.
summary: From Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto to Ayush Shetty and Unnati Hooda, here are the Indian shuttlers to watch at the BWF World Championships 2026.

title: The Journey of Indian Badminton: From Hyderabad to Delhi 2026
indian_angle: This feature explores the significant growth and transformation of Indian badminton over the past 17 years, leading up to the upcoming World Championships in Delhi.
summary: The 17 years of quiet, unglamorous institution-building between the first time the country hosted the World championships in 2009 and the upcoming edition in the capital have transformed the sport’s fortunes. The Hindu speaks to P.V. Sindhu, H.S. Prannoy, P. Gopi Chand, Ayush Shetty and BAI general secretary Sanjay Mishra to discover what this journey has entailed.

title: PM Modi: India Aims for Strong Contention at 2036 Olympics
indian_angle: Prime Minister Modi announced India's ambitious goal to become a strong contender for the 2036 Olympics, launching a nationwide talent hunt.
summary: We are launching a nationwide talent hunt for children aged 5 to 15 to identify prospects in every corner of the country. They will get special training to become world class athletes, says Prime Minister Modi.

title: Praggnanandhaa Draws with Leader Wesley So at Sinquefield Cup
indian_angle: Indian chess prodigy Praggnanandhaa secured a crucial draw against the tournament leader, maintaining his strong position in the Sinquefield Cup.
summary: The draw as black meant that Praggnanandhaa remained in the joint second spot in the 10-players-9-rounds event with 3 points out of a possible five in his bag now from five games.

title: India Joins Elite Club, Plays 600th Test Match
indian_angle: India has achieved a historic milestone by becoming only the third nation globally to play 600 Test matches.
summary: It is the third nation to achieve this feat after England (1097 Tests) and Australia (883 Tests).
